title: ABC Bank v. XYZ Steels (IBC)
text: The financial creditor, ABC Bank, filed this application before NCLT under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) for initiation of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) against the corporate debtor, XYZ Steels. The financial debt of Rs 120 crore is established through loan agreements and default is established from bank statements. The corporate debtor failed to repay the debt. The threshold under IBC for initiating CIRP is crossed. Under IBC, upon satisfaction of a financial debt and default, the adjudicating authority has no discretion to refuse admission. CIRP is admitted. An Interim Resolution Professional is appointed. The moratorium under Section 14 of IBC comes into force. The financial creditor is entitled to participate in the Committee of Creditors. The corporate debtor's management stands suspended during CIRP.
